description: The parser expected a value here (a number, a name, a function call, a probe such as `V(p, n)`, or an operator expression) and found something that cannot start one.
actions: Check for a missing operand, for example `a + ;` or `( )`.
Look at the source at the position shown, and at the end of the line before it: a syntax error is often noticed one token after the actual mistake.
